title: 吉拉索爾 FPSO 開發
summary: 吉拉索爾是 Block 17 浮式生產中心之一；課程以共用處理設施與海底連接的長期維護為主題。本課依序分析中心設施維修等待、連接管段壓降、海底接口檢驗趨勢、多來源液體分離、分配計量的誤差，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Girassol is a Block 17 floating hub; this case examines long-term upkeep of shared processing and subsea links. The course analyses hub-maintenance waiting, tieback-segment pressure loss, subsea-interface inspection trend, separation of multiple liquid sources, uncertainty in allocation metering, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 中心設施維修等待、連接管段壓降、海底接口檢驗趨勢
v31FocusEn: Hub-maintenance waiting; Tieback-segment pressure loss; Subsea-interface inspection trend

stages.titleEn: Resource conditions and system boundaries: Girassol FPSO development
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「中心設施維修等待」與「連接管段壓降」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hub-maintenance waiting" and "Tieback-segment pressure loss": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「中心設施維修等待」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hub-maintenance waiting" is correct?
options: 在簡化的可修復系統中，可用率等於平均故障間隔除以故障間隔加平均修復時間。
冗餘設備越多就能把共因失效機率變成零。
流速增加一成時，摩擦壓降也只增加一成。
optionsEn: For a simplified repairable system, availability equals mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time.
More redundant units reduce common-cause failure probability to zero.
A ten-percent velocity rise increases friction loss by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 在簡化的可修復系統中，可用率等於平均故障間隔除以故障間隔加平均修復時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For a simplified repairable system, availability equals mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instruction: 本案例的分析界面是「中心設施維修等待」。吉拉索爾是 Block 17 浮式生產中心之一；課程以共用處理設施與海底連接的長期維護為主題。在「吉拉索爾 FPSO 開發」的教學模型中，先把這個界面和相鄰設備分開，再使用下列方法。在簡化的可修復系統中，可用率等於平均故障間隔除以故障間隔加平均修復時間。平均值不能呈現海況造成的長尾等待，也不能描述共因失效；離岸系統的備件與交通限制往往先改變修復時間而非設備固有可靠度。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

quiz.question: 依「中心設施維修等待」的模型 A = MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR)，「中心設施維修等待」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model A = MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR) for "Hub-maintenance waiting", which value is closest to the simplified exercise for Hub-maintenance waiting; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.?

steps.title: 中心設施維修等待：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hub-maintenance waiting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「中心設施維修等待」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Hub-maintenance waiting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：A = MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR)；代入 MTBF = 2070 h、MTTR = 48 h，得 97.7 %（「中心設施維修等待」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 MTTR 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A = MTBF/(MTBF+MTTR); with MTBF = 2070 h, MTTR = 48 h the result is 97.7 % (simplified exercise for Hub-maintenance waiting; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise MTTR by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：MTTR 增加 10% 時，結果變為 97.5 %（-0.2%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising MTTR by 10% changes the result to 97.5 % (-0.2%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 97.7 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 MTTR 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 97.7 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in MTTR with an engineering explanation.

Any balance residual immediately proves a physical leak.
For “Hub-maintenance waiting”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis.

steps.title: 中心設施維修等待：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hub-maintenance waiting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「中心設施維修等待」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hub-maintenance waiting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 針對「中心設施維修等待」，建立帶有案例名稱與時間基準的證據表。把等待、診斷、備件與修復時間分開相加，重算教學可用率，再對比只縮短實際修理時間的方案。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: For “Hub-maintenance waiting”, create an evidence table identified by case and time basis. Separate waiting, diagnosis, spare delivery and repair time, recalculate teaching availability, and compare with an option that shortens hands-on repair only. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：成果檔以 027-01 標記，圖表須寫明「吉拉索爾 FPSO 開發：教學假設」。交付停機分類表與可用率範圍，將預防維護、故障與物流停等保持可追溯。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label the output 027-01 and mark charts “Girassol FPSO development: teaching assumptions”. Deliver a downtime classification and availability range, retaining traceability among preventive maintenance, failures and logistics delays.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：「中心設施維修等待」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An error at “Hub-maintenance waiting” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「中心設施維修等待」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hub-maintenance waiting" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 「中心設施維修等待」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
流速增加一成時，摩擦壓降也只增加一成。
optionsEn: An error at “Hub-maintenance waiting” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
A ten-percent velocity rise increases friction loss by only ten percent.

steps.title: 中心設施維修等待：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hub-maintenance waiting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「中心設施維修等待」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Hub-maintenance waiting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 「中心設施維修等待」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。把天候待命從停機帳刪除會高估可用率；兩台冗餘設備共用電源時，也不能假定失效完全獨立。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「吉拉索爾 FPSO 開發」的安全、交付、壽命或環境。
steps.instructionEn: An error at “Hub-maintenance waiting” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Removing weather waiting from downtime inflates availability; redundant units sharing one power source cannot be assumed to fail independently. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, delivery, life or environment of “Girassol FPSO development”.

Using outside rather than inside diameter changes velocity and friction estimates; forcing multiphase flow into a liquid-only equation hides slug-related peaks behind the mean value.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
